name: Supercell, 250 m
line: The same storm with four times finer detail: gust fronts and the hook show up.
note: Fitted to your GPU: a smaller area, then a coarser grid, then a shorter storm time, in that order.

changes.why: the same 120 km area at 250 m
the same 120 km area at 250 m
80 levels of 250 m: the same 20 km depth at twice the vertical detail (CM1's file has 40 of 500 m)
the time step scaled with the grid spacing, as CM1 advises (6 s at 1 km)
a picture every 5 minutes, so the live view moves
netCDF, which ncview, xarray and most tools read (CM1's file asks for GrADS)
one file per saved time, so each picture has its own file

storm_appears.basis: measured: on the 1 km grid the first echo above 5 dBZ is in the column at T+0:20:00 and at 1 km at T+0:30:00; on the 250 m grid there is none at T+0:15:00 and both at T+0:30:00 (CM1's warm bubble)
